1874-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

1424-3881-7515.easyPrerequisites:
Blistercoil Weird doesn't have summoning sickness.
Presence of Gond is attached to Blistercoil Weird.
1424-3881-7515.description:
Activate Blistercoil Weird using the ability granted to it by Presence of Gond by tapping it, creating a creature token.
When the token enters, Spiritcall Enthusiast triggers, causing it to become prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {W}.
Cast a copy of Scrollboost by paying {W}, targeting any valid target(s).
Blistercoil Weird triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping it.
Resolve Scrollboost, giving up to two creatures +2/+2 each until end of turn.
Repeat.

1531-2173-4496-5220.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
When Accursed Centaur enters, it triggers, sacrificing itself.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Deathgreeter trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1981-2034-2415-2999.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2034-2415-2999.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

2760-6854.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two other creatures with toughness equal to 1.
You have a way to put a -1/-1 counter on a creature.
2760-6854.description:
Put a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to 1. The creatue dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Nest of Scarabs and Host of the Hereafter.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to 1.
Resolve the Nest of Scarabs trigger, creating a 1/1 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
2760-6854.notes: You can alternatively start the combo with one creature that has toughness equal to 1 and another creature that has a -1/-1 counter on it. If you do, kill the creature with a -1/-1 counter on it to start the combo.

757-2348-3933-5087.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-2348-3933-5087.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Karn's Bastion to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Nature's Revolt, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

475-1379-2919-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-1379-2919-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2204-2921-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Scholar of New Horizons.
When Scholar of New Horizons dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1189-5016-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
1189-5016-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Spitemare indestructible using Eldrazi Monument.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Spitemare.
Spitemare triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
1189-5016-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3192-6798-6972.easyPrerequisites: The number of red creatures you control excluding Ulasht plus the number of green creatures you control excluding Ulasht is at least X.
3192-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ulasht.
When Ulasht dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

141-5686-7449.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-5686-7449.description:
Cast Stir the Grave by paying {4}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stir the Grave.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stir the Grave
Resolve the Stir the Grave copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

891-2961-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, False Demise triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3967-5170-6132-7286.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1978-4747-5776.notablePrerequisites: You had a creature with power 3 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

3054-4050-4668.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
3054-4050-4668.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
3054-4050-4668.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1682-2366-3480-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1682-2366-3480-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

4943-5465-7070.description:
Activate Lancers en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Lancers en-Kor.
The Lancers en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Lancers en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
Repeat.

81-3693-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

167-2974-4871.description:
Cast Repository Skaab by paying {3}{U}.
When Repository Skaab enters, its exploit ability triggers.
Holding priority, cast Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting Repository Skaab.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, causing it to exploit itself. 
Pitiless Plunderer, Repository Skaab's second ability and Repository Skaab's ability gained from Not Dead After All trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve the first Repository Skaab trigger, returning Not Dead After All from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second Repository Skaab trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Pitiless Plunderer, the Wicked Role token, Repository Skaab's second ability and Repository Skaab's ability gained from Not Dead After All trigger.
Resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 6.

1251-3259-5734.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant.
1251-3259-5734.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any creature you control except Death Tyrant, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1358-4871-5686.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that is boosting the toughness of all your creatures by at least 1.
You control at least one additional creature.
1358-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Sydri's first ability by paying {U}, causing the Blood token to become an artifact creature until end of turn. The Blood token will not die due to the permanent stated in the pre-requisites causing its toughness to be 1 or greater.
Repeat.

575-4319-5231-5441.notablePrerequisites: Skirk Alarmist does not have summoning sickness.
575-4319-5231-5441.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Granite Witness, adding {R}.
When Granite Witness dies, Yedora triggers, returning Granite Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate Granite Witness by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Granite Witness face-up.
Granite Witness triggers, untapping Skirk Alarmist.
Repeat.

1322-3493-4289.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1322-3493-4289.description:
Activate Patrol Signaler and another creature you control by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Activate Patrol Signaler by paying {1}{W} and untapping it, creating a 1/1 Kithkin Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

1379-1558-2526.notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten Zombies.
1379-1558-2526.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Endless Ranks of the Dead triggers, creating at least five 2/2 Zombie creature tokens that are artifacts due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Zombies, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2034-3895-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Diregraf Horde.
Diregraf Horde enters the battlefield, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2744-3192-4214.notablePrerequisites: Ulasht has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2744-3192-4214.description:
Activate Ulasht by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Utopia Mycon by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2050-3525-4327.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Arbor Elf.
Sheltered Aerie attached to a Forest you control.
2050-3525-4327.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the enchanted forest.
Activate the ability granted to the Forest by Sheltered Aerie, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite blue mana, you may tap the Forest for other colors instead of blue, adding infinite colored mana.

3277-4305-4872.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Izzet Chronarch.
3277-4305-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Izzet Chronarch.
Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp to your hand.
Repeat.
